properties.summary: No approved footprints are published, so this is an illustrative envelope: BART's parcels drawn to the approved height of 61 ft. Real buildings will cover less of the land.
properties.note: An envelope at the approved height, not the approved design.
properties.license: Parcels and zoning: BART public ArcGIS Online service (no license stated)

properties.label: Amador Station
properties.source: illustrative: BART parcels drawn to the approved height, 5 stories and 61 ft, of the Site Development Review the City of Dublin approved on Aug 10, 2021 (https://dublin-development.icitywork.com/#projectDetail1380); the zoning limit is 90 ft (BART's AB 2923 rezoned layer, “Min: 0 Max: 90 feet or 8 stories”, https://services.arcgis.com/sqS7RNuF1BQinj5N/arcgis/rest/services/BART_AB_2923_Public_Service_20230201/FeatureServer/9)
properties.note: 300 affordable homes in two buildings of 136 and 164 (City of Dublin); building permits for the first building are under review (City of Dublin) and construction awaits funding (BART). The approved footprints aren't published, so the parcels are drawn whole. OpenStreetMap has two footprints here tagged building=construction (checked 2023); no official source says work has started, so they aren't treated as buildings.
